(program "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos#main"
  (packages "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos" "std/lesson" "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos#main")
  (main "main"
    (vars (0 nodes local list of paxos.Node))
    (body
      (native "sim.seed" 105)
      (native "net.latency" (time 10000) (time 40000))
      (set nodes#0 (native "sim.cluster" 3 (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos")))
      (call "paxos.Meet" nodes#0)
      (deliver (message paxos.Start (Value "x")) (item nodes#0 0))
      (after (time 15000)
        (deliver (message paxos.Start (Value "y")) (item nodes#0 2))
        (call "lesson.Ask … choosing" "Two proposers are racing. Can both x and y be chosen?" (list "Yes: each proposer's value is chosen at its own ballot" "No: the higher ballot wins, so y alone is chosen" "No: the second proposer learns of x and proposes x too" "Neither: the proposers block each other forever")))
      (native "sim.stopAt" (time 2000000))))
  (package "std/disk" std
    (runs "std/disk"))
  (package "std/lists" std
    (runs "std/lists"))
  (package "std/math" std
    (runs "std/math"))
  (package "std/net" std
    (runs "std/net"))
  (package "std/sim" std
    (runs "std/sim"))
  (package "std/text" std
    (runs "std/text"))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos"
    (uses "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/text")
    (runs "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos")
    (node-fields
      (field Peers list of paxos.Node exported (empty list of paxos.Node))
      (field Promised number exported 0)
      (field AcceptedBallot number exported 0)
      (field AcceptedValue text exported "")
      (field Chosen text exported "")
      (field round number 0)
      (field ballot number 0)
      (field proposal text "")
      (field promises list of paxos.Promise (empty list of paxos.Promise))
      (field votes map of text to number (empty map of text to number)))
    (record Start exported
      (field Value text exported ""))
    (record Learned exported
      (field Value text exported ""))
    (record Prepare exported
      (field number number 0))
    (record Promise exported
      (field number number 0)
      (field prior number 0)
      (field priorValue text ""))
    (record Accept exported
      (field number number 0)
      (field value text ""))
    (record Accepted exported
      (field number number 0)
      (field value text ""))
    (start "start"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 paxos.Promised (native "disk.read" "promised" n#0 0))
        (set-field n#0 paxos.AcceptedBallot (native "disk.read" "acceptedBallot" n#0 0))
        (set-field n#0 paxos.AcceptedValue (native "disk.read" "acceptedValue" n#0 ""))
        (set-field n#0 paxos.round (native "disk.read" "round" n#0 0))))
    (phrase "Meet"
      (vars (0 ns param list of paxos.Node) (1 n each paxos.Node))
      (body
        (each _ n#1 ns#0
          (set-field n#1 paxos.Peers ns#0))))
    (phrase "Majority of" (result number)
      (vars (0 n param number))
      (body
        (result (plus (native "math.floor" (divided-by n#0 2)) 1))))
    (phrase "Propose"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node) (1 v param text) (2 p each paxos.Node))
      (body
        (set-field n#0 paxos.round (plus (nodefield n#0 paxos.round) 1))
        (native "disk.write" (nodefield n#0 paxos.round) "round" n#0)
        (set-field n#0 paxos.ballot (plus (times (nodefield n#0 paxos.round) 100) (native "sim.id" n#0)))
        (set-field n#0 paxos.proposal v#1)
        (set-field n#0 paxos.promises (empty list of paxos.Promise))
        (each _ p#2 (nodefield n#0 paxos.Peers)
          (native "net.send" (message paxos.Prepare (number (nodefield n#0 paxos.ballot))) n#0 p#2))))
    (phrase "ChosenValues" (result list of text)
      (vars (0 values local list of text) (1 n each paxos.Node) (2 c local text))
      (body
        (set values#0 (empty list of text))
        (each _ n#1 (native "sim.nodesRunning" (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos"))
          (set c#2 (nodefield n#1 paxos.Chosen))
          (if (and (is-not c#2 "") (not-in c#2 values#0))
            (then
              (set values#0 (native "lists.append" c#2 values#0)))))
        (result values#0)))
    (when-node "sim.delivered"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node) (1 Start binding paxos.Start))
      (match 0 record paxos.Start Start#1)
      (body
        (call "paxos.Propose" (recv n#0) (recfield Start#1 Value))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node) (1 Prepare binding paxos.Prepare) (2 proposer binding node))
      (match 0 record paxos.Prepare Prepare#1)
      (match 1 bind proposer#2)
      (body
        (if (more-than (recfield Prepare#1 number) (nodefield n#0 paxos.Promised))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 paxos.Promised (recfield Prepare#1 number))
            (native "disk.write" (nodefield n#0 paxos.Promised) "promised" n#0)
            (native "net.send" (message paxos.Promise (number (nodefield n#0 paxos.Promised)) (prior (nodefield n#0 paxos.AcceptedBallot)) (priorValue (nodefield n#0 paxos.AcceptedValue))) n#0 proposer#2)))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node) (1 Promise binding paxos.Promise) (2 acceptor binding node) (3 best local number) (4 p each paxos.Promise) (5 a each paxos.Node))
      (match 0 record paxos.Promise Promise#1)
      (match 1 bind acceptor#2)
      (body
        (if (is (recfield Promise#1 number) (nodefield n#0 paxos.ballot))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 paxos.promises (native "lists.append" Promise#1 (nodefield n#0 paxos.promises)))
            (if (is (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 paxos.promises)) (call "paxos.Majority of" (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 paxos.Peers))))
              (then
                (set best#3 0)
                (each _ p#4 (nodefield n#0 paxos.promises)
                  (if (more-than (recfield p#4 prior) best#3)
                    (then
                      (set best#3 (recfield p#4 prior))
                      (set-field n#0 paxos.proposal (recfield p#4 priorValue)))))
                (each _ a#5 (nodefield n#0 paxos.Peers)
                  (native "net.send" (message paxos.Accept (number (nodefield n#0 paxos.ballot)) (value (nodefield n#0 paxos.proposal))) n#0 a#5))))))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node) (1 Accept binding paxos.Accept) (2 proposer binding node) (3 p each paxos.Node))
      (match 0 record paxos.Accept Accept#1)
      (match 1 bind proposer#2)
      (body
        (if (at-least (recfield Accept#1 number) (nodefield n#0 paxos.Promised))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 paxos.Promised (recfield Accept#1 number))
            (set-field n#0 paxos.AcceptedBallot (recfield Accept#1 number))
            (set-field n#0 paxos.AcceptedValue (recfield Accept#1 value))
            (native "disk.write" (nodefield n#0 paxos.Promised) "promised" n#0)
            (native "disk.write" (nodefield n#0 paxos.AcceptedBallot) "acceptedBallot" n#0)
            (native "disk.write" (nodefield n#0 paxos.AcceptedValue) "acceptedValue" n#0)
            (each _ p#3 (nodefield n#0 paxos.Peers)
              (native "net.send" (message paxos.Accepted (number (recfield Accept#1 number)) (value (recfield Accept#1 value))) n#0 p#3))))))
    (when-node "net.received"
      (vars (0 n receiver paxos.Node) (1 Accepted binding paxos.Accepted) (2 acceptor binding node) (3 key local text))
      (match 0 record paxos.Accepted Accepted#1)
      (match 1 bind acceptor#2)
      (body
        (set key#3 (native "text.from" (recfield Accepted#1 number)))
        (if (in key#3 (nodefield n#0 paxos.votes) map)
          (then
            (set-item (nodefield n#0 paxos.votes) key#3 (plus (item (nodefield n#0 paxos.votes) key#3 map) 1) map))
          (else
            (set-item (nodefield n#0 paxos.votes) key#3 1 map)))
        (if (is (item (nodefield n#0 paxos.votes) key#3 map) (call "paxos.Majority of" (native "lists.size" (nodefield n#0 paxos.Peers))))
          (then
            (set-field n#0 paxos.Chosen (recfield Accepted#1 value))
            (emit (message paxos.Learned (Value (nodefield n#0 paxos.Chosen))) n#0)))))
    (always "paxos/paxos.synod:125: always ((lists.Size ChosenValues) at most 1)" (at-most (native "lists.size" (call "paxos.ChosenValues")) 1) (slots 0)))
  (package "std/lesson" std
    (uses "std/sim")
    (runs "std/sim" "std/lesson")
    (record Asked exported
      (field Question text exported "")
      (field Choices list of text exported (empty list of text)))
    (record Noted exported
      (field Text text exported ""))
    (phrase "Ask"
      (vars (0 q param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0)) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Ask … choosing"
      (vars (0 q param text) (1 c param list of text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Asked (Question q#0) (Choices (native "lesson.choices" c#1))) (native "sim.nobody"))))
    (phrase "Note"
      (vars (0 t param text))
      (body
        (emit (message lesson.Noted (Text t#0)) (native "sim.nobody")))))
  (package "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos#main" main
    (uses "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos" "std/lesson" "std/net" "std/sim")
    (runs "std/disk" "std/lists" "std/math" "std/net" "std/sim" "std/text" "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos" "std/lesson" "github.com/synodlang/examples/paxos#main")))
